input.free_text_description: This system is an e-commerce platform that serves Customer, User roles. It manages core business objects including order main, user, product in order, cart. The platform provides capabilities for user, cart, product. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Customer, I want to create and manage order main records, so that I can track and organize order main data effectively.
As a Customer, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a Customer, I want to create and manage product in order records, so that I can track and organize product in order data effectively.
As a Customer, I want to create and manage cart records, so that I can track and organize cart data effectively.
